title: Cover and Safehouse
author: Rosalind Nystrom
blurb: Cyrus Ravensworth, an interpreter attached to a peace delegation destined to fail, works cases no one wants attributed. But when a voiceprint unlocks a server on another continent, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must get the truth past three governments and one assassin before the summit convenes.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
